meter: One file version made available in a verified recipient’s Fyde inbox, or accepted by an external delivery provider for one recipient, counts as one send. These events count once together. Idempotent retries and repeat downloads do not add sends. A definitive provider failure reverses a send only if the file was never available in the inbox or accessed. Local fixture usage has a separate ledger.
resource_policy: Uploads: 25 MiB per file. Download bandwidth is a separate monthly resource limit, reserved on each actual download. Unlimited has no file-send count cap. No overage charges. Exceeding a resource limit pauses the affected action and keeps export available. Cancellation retains files; deletion is owner initiated. These limits are experimental.
